positions.title: Medical Transcriptionist

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
State of Mississippi: Drivers License Division, Highway Patrol, Sex Offenders Registry.
Provided Natural/Adabas system monitoring, bug fixes, & training for programming staff.
Investigated and corrected transient error issues within the Sex Offender Registry.
Prepared driver licenses and IDs for undercover officers.
Coordinated small business server upgrades and after-hours system conversions.
Ensured secure access, building re-lock, and alarm reset after nightly conversions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Variety of applications.  Currently working with Natural, and Cobol applications, reading and processing ticket lift information from an EDI IATA file into a revenue pipeline.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Led analysis and enhancement of IBM-based credit card billing and SOFRS government reporting systems.
Conducted cross-system testing and validation for BSP international processing.
Authored full SDLC documentation ensuring SOX and internal audit compliance.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Spearheaded Natural/Adabas modernization and data conversion projects.
Streamlined drawdown and TPA reprocess functionality.
Produced compliance documentation and enhanced reporting efficiency.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
Re-engineered RMA systems, reducing profit loss from 26% to 8%.
Integrated MARC Warehouse and customer RMA systems for online visibility.
Designed EDI interfaces (X.12 standards) for purchase order and shipment transactions.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
Developed health and life insurance systems using Natural/Adabas.
Collaborated with actuaries to analyze risk and policy performance.
Led QA testing and implemented process control improvements.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Civil Aviation Security and Flight Standards systems.
Supported compliance, software change management, and reporting.
Recognized for superior technical proficiency and training contributions.
